feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 17 June 2026 4:16pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 17 June 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure to the south of Iceland and high pressure over continental Europe, with frontal zones affecting the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, increasing 5 or 6 tomorrow morning.


##State of Sea##

Slight occasionally moderate, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain spreading from the west tomorrow morning, becoming mainly fair later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or southwest 5 or 6, but 3 to 5 in the southeast of the area.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, but slight in the southeast of the area.


##Weather##

Mainly fair, only patchy drizzle, then a risk of mist and fog patches spreading from the south. Rain later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain or mist. Very poor in fog patches.
